```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(my_wd_all_dat))
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
data_raw <- st_read("./data_prep_output/parcels_predictors_05_final.gpkg")
```

## Define model of interest

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# runs via 00_run_all
cat("Selected model:", selected_model)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
dat <- data_raw %>%
  filter(parceltype == selected_model)
```

## Data perparation

```{r, include=FALSE}
## Preprocessing
# Convert categorical variables to factors
dat$dep_dens <- as.factor(dat$dep_dens)
summary(dat$dep_dens)

# remove variables which are not needed in the model
base_drop <- c(
  "dep_dens_cat", "dif_fa", "dif_fa_perc", "dep_fa_23", "parceltype", "service_quality_chg", "service_quality_2020", "center_quality"
)

nbu_extra_drop <- c(
  "dep_dens_cat", "dif_fa", "dif_fa_perc", "dep_fa_23", "parceltype",
  "share_area_foot_par", "share_floorspace_par", "largest_nonbuiltup", "fa_13",
  "bldg_flats_sum", "ucp_par", "bldg_age_median", "par_renov_recon", "bldg_type",
  "persons_total_par", "persons_per_fa", "ave_age_par", "only_75_older_par",
  "under_16_present_par", "share_area_par_nbr", "share_floorspace_par_nbr"
)

drop_cols <- if (params$run_id == "nbu") {
  nbu_extra_drop
} else {
  base_drop
}

data_reg <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(drop_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.factor))


# Check for missing values
sum(is.na(data_reg))

# Remove rows with missing values (if necessary)
data <- na.omit(data_reg)
```

## Preparations for tidymodel

```{r}
trainDat <- data

predictor_names <- trainDat %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  select(id_par_merge, area_par:bezirksteil) %>% # id can be kept, as later on we define it as ID in the recipe
  names()

predictor_names

response_name <- "dep_dens"
```

### Define recipe including balancing of training data and tunable feature selection

```{r define-recipe}
formula <- as.formula(paste(
  response_name,
  "~",
  paste(predictor_names, collapse = " + ")
))

recipe <- recipes::recipe(formula, data = trainDat) %>% 
  update_role(id_par_merge, new_role = "ID") %>%
  update_role(bezirksteil, new_role = "ID") %>%
  update_role(bezirk, new_role = "ID") %>%
  step_downsample(dep_dens, under_ratio = 1) %>% 
  important::step_predictor_best(
    all_predictors(),
    score      = "imp_rf",
    prop_terms = tune(),
    id         = "feat_sel"
  )

recipe
```

### Define model

```{r define-model-spec}
rf_model <- parsnip::rand_forest(mode = "classification") %>% 
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity")
```

### Create workflow

```{r create-workflow}
workflow <- workflows::workflow() %>% 
  workflows::add_recipe(recipe) %>% 
  workflows::add_model(rf_model)
workflow
```

### Define spatial cross validation

```{r define-cv}
set.seed(123)
block_folds <- spatialsample::spatial_block_cv(data, v = 4, n = 2)

spatialsample::autoplot(block_folds)

# control cross-validation
keep_pred <- tune::control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE, save_workflow = TRUE)
```

### Define tuning grid for feature selection

```{r tuning-grid}
prop_grid <- tibble::tibble(
    prop_terms = seq(0.5, 1.0, by = 0.1)  
)
prop_grid
```

### Tune model with spatial cross-validation

```{r tune-model}
set.seed(123)

rf_tuned <- tune::tune_grid(
  workflow,
  resamples = block_folds,
  grid      = prop_grid,
  control   = keep_pred
)

rf_tuned
```

#### ROC-AUC across tuning parameter values

```{r roc-metrics}
metrics_all <- tune::collect_metrics(rf_tuned)

metrics_roc <- metrics_all %>% 
  dplyr::filter(.metric == "roc_auc") %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean))

metrics_roc
```

```{r roc-metrics-table, results='asis'}
knitr::kable(
  metrics_roc,
  caption = "ROC-AUC across different values of prop_terms (feature selection fraction).",
  digits = 3
)
```

```{r roc-metrics-plot, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
ggplot(metrics_roc, aes(x = prop_terms, y = mean)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - std_err, ymax = mean + std_err), width = 0.02) +
  labs(
    x = "Fraction of Predictors Kept (prop_terms)",
    y = "Mean ROC-AUC",
    title = "ROC-AUC vs. Feature Selection Fraction",
    subtitle = "Error bars show +/- 1 standard error"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Model performance

#### Confusion matrix for best tuned configuration

```{r conf-matrix}
## Select best prop_terms by ROC AUC
best_prop <- tune::select_best(rf_tuned, metric = "roc_auc")
best_prop

## Predictions for the best tuning configuration
preds <- tune::collect_predictions(rf_tuned, parameters = best_prop)
preds
conf_matrix <- yardstick::conf_mat(preds, dep_dens, .pred_class)
conf_matrix
```

#### Performance for top-ranked parcels matching projection procedure

```{r top-ranked-performance}

## Historical densification share used for the baseline projection
projection_share <- mean(
  dat$dep_dens == "densification",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

cat(
  "Projection share:",
  round(projection_share * 100, 2),
  "%\n"
)


## Identify spatial CV fold/repetition columns
fold_cols <- intersect(
  c("id", "id2"),
  names(preds)
)


## Calculate precision among the top-ranked parcels
## separately for each spatial CV assessment fold

precision_at_share <- preds %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(fold_cols))) %>%
  group_modify(~ {

    ## Number of parcels in the assessment fold
    n_total <- nrow(.x)

    ## Number of parcels to select according to the
    ## historical densification share
    n_select <- round(n_total * projection_share)
    n_select <- max(1, n_select)

    ## Rank ALL parcels by predicted probability and
    ## select the top-ranked proportion
    selected <- .x %>%
      arrange(desc(.pred_densification)) %>%
      slice_head(n = n_select)

    ## True positives:
    ## selected parcels that actually densified
    tp <- sum(
      selected$dep_dens == "densification",
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    ## False positives:
    ## selected parcels that did not densify
    fp <- sum(
      selected$dep_dens != "densification",
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    ## Precision = TP / (TP + FP)
    precision <- tp / (tp + fp)

    tibble(
      n_total = n_total,
      n_selected = n_select,
      TP = tp,
      FP = fp,
      precision_at_share = precision
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()


precision_at_share

```

```{r precision-at-projection-share-summary}

## Mean and standard deviation across spatial CV folds/repetitions

precision_at_share_summary <- precision_at_share %>%
  summarise(
    projection_share = projection_share,

    precision_at_share_mean = mean(
      precision_at_share,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    precision_at_share_sd = sd(
      precision_at_share,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


precision_at_share_summary

```


#### ROC-AUC based on preds

```{r}
roc_best <- yardstick::roc_auc(
  preds,
  truth = dep_dens,
  .pred_densification
)

roc <- roc_best$.estimate
```

#### Precision, Recall, F1, Balanced Accuracy

```{r prf1-bacc, echo=FALSE}
tp <- conf_matrix$table[1, 1]
fp <- conf_matrix$table[1, 2]
fn <- conf_matrix$table[2, 1]
tn <- conf_matrix$table[2, 2]

# Precision
precision <- tp / (tp + fp)

# Recall (Sensitivity)
recall <- tp / (tp + fn)

# F1 Score
f1 <- 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)

# Balanced Accuracy
BAcc <- 0.5 * (tp / (tp + fn) + tn / (tn + fp))

# Print results
cat("Precision:", round(precision, 2), "\n")
cat("Recall:", round(recall, 2), "\n")
cat("F1 Score:", round(f1, 2), "\n")
cat("Balanced Accuracy:", round(BAcc, 2), "\n")
cat("ROC-AUC:", round(roc, 2), "\n")
cat("Precision at projection share:",  round(precision_at_share_summary$precision_at_share_mean, 3),
  "+/-", round(precision_at_share_summary$precision_at_share_sd, 3), "\n")

# save in dataframe
results_df <- data.frame(
  Model = selected_model,
  Balanced_Accuracy = BAcc,
  Precision = precision,
  Recall = recall,
  F1_Score = f1,
  ROC_AUC = roc,

  Projection_Share = projection_share,

  Precision_at_Projection_Share =
    precision_at_share_summary$precision_at_share_mean,

  Precision_at_Projection_Share_SD =
    precision_at_share_summary$precision_at_share_sd
)
```

```{r fit-final-model}

set.seed(123)

rf_final <- final_wf %>%

rf_final
```

```{r feature-importance}
imp

var_imp <- imp[["data"]]
```

#### Extract predictors finally used

```{r}
predictors_used <- var_imp %>%

predictors_used
```

## SHAP / Shapley values

### 1) Get exact data used by the workflow

```{r}
set.seed(123)

mold <- workflows::extract_mold(rf_final)
X_all <- as.data.frame(mold$predictors)
y_all <- mold$outcomes[[1]]

# Engine model
rf_fit <- workflows::extract_fit_engine(rf_final)

# Prediction wrapper (probability of positive class)
pos_class <- "densification"
pred_fun <- function(object, newdata) {
  p <- predict(object, data = newdata, type = "response")$predictions
  as.numeric(p[, pos_class])
}
```

### 2) Stratified sample of rows to EXPLAIN

```{r}
n_explain <- 4000

idx_by_class <- split(seq_len(nrow(X_all)), y_all)
k <- length(idx_by_class)
n_per_class <- ceiling(n_explain / k)

idx_explain <- unlist(lapply(idx_by_class, function(idx) {
  sample(idx, size = min(length(idx), n_per_class), replace = FALSE)
}), use.names = FALSE)

# trim to exactly n_explain if needed
if (length(idx_explain) > n_explain) idx_explain <- sample(idx_explain, n_explain)

X_explain <- X_all[idx_explain, , drop = FALSE]
```

### 3) Compute SHAP on subset

```{r}
set.seed(123)
shap_mat <- fastshap::explain(
  object       = rf_fit,
  X            = X_explain,
  pred_wrapper = pred_fun,
  nsim         = 100,
  adjust       = TRUE
)

dim(shap_mat)
```
